links.explanation: Both reports concern the speed limit and associated signage on the A35 Barrack Road in Christchurch, Dorset. The earlier report highlights excessive speeds and lack of effective controls, while the later report questions whether the correct speed limit is set and whether adequate bend warning signs exist.
